annotations.title: Autonomous Lead Contact, Email, Phone & Social Handle Extractor

description: Extracts email addresses, telephone numbers, physical addresses, and social network handles from web text and DOM footers. Use when researching sales leads, aggregating business contact directories, or extracting customer service info; for parsing structured tabular data, use parse_html_tables instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'content' ('extraction_focus' defaults to 'all_contacts'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

content.description: Raw text or HTML page content to scan for contact channels and lead info.

country_hint.description: Two-letter ISO country code for telephone numbering format hints.

extraction_focus.description: Contact filter focus: all contact info, emails and phones only, or social handles only.

name: extract_contact_info

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for extract_contact_info.

emails.description: Deduplicated valid email addresses extracted from page content.

phone_numbers.description: Standardized telephone numbers discovered in international or national format.

physical_addresses.description: Postal addresses or physical headquarters locations identified.

social_profiles.description: Identified social profiles (Twitter/X, GitHub, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram).

title: Autonomous Lead Contact, Email, Phone & Social Handle Extractor
